type.description: Blob type tag the network dispatches on to pick a decoder and rules, such as `Change` or `Ref`.

signer.description: Public key of the account or device that signed the blob.

sig.description: Signature over the canonical DAG-CBOR of the blob with `sig` set to 64 zero bytes.

ts.description: When the signer says the blob was made, in Unix milliseconds; not checked against real time.

description: The signed envelope every Hypermedia blob extends: a type tag, the signer's key, a signature and a millisecond timestamp.
